title: How to Build an E-Commerce Site with AI (No Coding Required)
summary: Build a full online store — product listings, cart, Stripe payments, user accounts, and order management — without writing a single line of code. Step-by-step guide.
body_markdown: Yes. Blink supports Stripe Checkout and Stripe Payment Intents. Describe the payment flow you want and Blink generates the integration code. You connect your Stripe account by pasting your live publishable and secret keys from your Stripe dashboard when prompted — only live keys are accepted, test keys are rejected. Stripe's fraud protection and compliance are included automatically.
